sources.transcription_note: Formula subscripts are represented inline; the printed line break within 50-fold is joined without deleting its hyphen.
sources.source_caveat: The source labels these notebook methods informational and not for citation in publication. It reproduces Vogel's 1956 directions with permission; it is not the linked 1964 article.
sources.finding: The source distinguishes a concentrated salts preparation, its fiftyfold dilution, a nested trace stock and a separate biotin stock. Salt mass cannot be assigned directly to an elemental-ion amount. Carbon-source variants also require separate treatment.

linked_original_article.access_result: JSTOR supplied no recipe text; publisher open returned HTTP 403. Search metadata identified the DOI, but the article methods were not inspected.

disposition: Retain the primary-source hold. Do not apply the evidence-only draft or divide all existing values by a guessed common factor. Resolve the 1964 formulation, compound-versus-ion accounting, nested stock boundaries, missing constituents, molecular forms and carbon-source variant first.

additional_lead.search_result: An institutional publication list and author CV identify the 1995 article; a 1993 thesis title is a further lead. No recipe methods or defensible replacement for 1000 mM thiamine were read.
